notes.note: The public MCP Client exercised the real HTTP tool endpoint and the production scoped Agent catalog. It received the member projection for an admitted stored Agent and an identical not-found result for a nonexistent slug and a stored operator-only Agent. The actual catalog received the same minted caller credential on all three requests. The former detail-path fault failed the catalog path assertion, and restoration passed the affected suites.
